method: Same pristine QR candidate, exact payload bytes, QR version, ECC, mask and rotation for each before/after pair. Baseline full pipeline chooses its best square-module artwork. New drawing receives that same pristine candidate, tries square artwork plus the pristine centers, and chooses a verified picture. Both drawings measured by normalized luminance MAE at 8 pixels/module, excluding the quiet zone but including protected structure. Binary geometry uses a repeated module target; the photograph uses the supplied 147x147 RGB image. These are five fixtures, not an arbitrary-image quality or real-camera guarantee.
